preamble: INSTRUCTION TO THE ASSISTANT (read first). Every numeric in this bundle carries a {point, ci_lo, ci_hi, uncertainty_status} schema and every claim carries a `must_carry` list of caveats. OMITTING AN ATTACHED CI OR CAVEAT IS AN ERROR, NOT A SUMMARIZATION CHOICE. Specifically: (1) trade questions MUST report BOTH pools (consensus AND corpus) with their CIs — never a single verdict; (2) 'unmeasured' means the sampling variance was never computed — say so, do not present it as certain; (3) startup-strategy questions MUST carry no-strategy-recommended AND the corpus-size bind; (4) archetype/college questions MUST carry 'indistinguishable from capital' / 'uninformative test at these event counts (not a null)', never a yes/no. If the bundle does not support a question, cite the matching `cannot_answer` entry instead of improvising. CAVEAT-RETENTION WAS VERIFIED AGAINST ONE MODEL FAMILY ONLY (Claude Opus 4.8) and self-graded by the authoring session; a different consumer model at draft time is UNTESTED — do not assume another model will retain these caveats.

claims.headline: Archetype clusters are statistically INDISTINGUISHABLE from draft-capital-only on the 2019-2022 test set (704 players, 43 hits): gap −0.00025, DeLong paired SE 0.0153 (corr 0.777, z=−0.02), 95% CI [−0.0303, +0.0298] — which EXCLUDES any true gap larger than ~0.03 AUC in magnitude. The refit-over-players CI [−0.084, +0.018] is a different estimand (training-instability-inflated), not this SE. Whether a gap below ~0.03 matters for a board depends on a decision-relevant AUC threshold; the 0.02–0.03 figure floated in review is an UNSOURCED reviewer-supplied constant pending derivation, so no such claim is made.

claims.provenance_note: PRIMARY = the pre-registered perm_diff test (fixed tertiles, outcome-shuffle within top∪bottom, middle EXCLUDED) + its coherent family-wise correction on the SAME set. The dom-shuffle joint null (middle INCLUDED) is a POST-HOC amendment (PHASE8_PLAN §A3) under a DIFFERENT exchangeable set. The two family-wise p's are NOT two views of one test.
claims.retracted: An earlier min-selection-artifact interval [retracted] and an independence-based expected-minimum benchmark [withdrawn] MUST NOT be reported.
claims.headline: No college-production signal beyond draft capital was DEMONSTRATED, and the pre-registered test COULD NOT have demonstrated one at these event counts — an UNINFORMATIVE test, not a null. Raw top5 (ceiling-target) events per stratum (top-tertile/bottom-tertile): R1 6/6, R2 6/4, R3 2/1, R4-7 3/2 (middle-tertile 5/0/3/0). The pre-registered rule needs a directional tertile lift with perm p<0.05 in ≥2 of 3 non-R1 strata; at ≤6 events/tertile that p<0.05 is unreachable, so 0/3 strata are informative — the 0/3 result means the test could not satisfy its own rule, not that the effect is absent. The pre-registered Westfall-Young family-wise p = 0.645 shows only that the minimum of the 24 marginal p's is unremarkable given their correlation; it does NOT establish no-effect or equivalence (same underpowered counts). Draft-capital-only was not improved on here because the test lacked the events to improve on it. (A non-pre-registered dom-shuffle variant gives family-wise p 0.4794 — reported for transparency, not the pre-registered test.)

cannot_answer.question: What is player X's single, context-free dynasty trade value / value ranking?
cannot_answer.reason: Not built. The engine outputs trade DELTAS (E[Δ] VORP) under two pick-outcome pools, not a context-free per-player value. A ranking that hides the pool assumption would violate Standing Constraint #4.

cannot_answer.question: What is the optimal startup-draft strategy / who do I pick at slot X?
cannot_answer.reason: No strategy has a validated edge (Gate 6.5); the corpus (≤15 effective SF-startup units in 2021) cannot support a recommendation. Report the null + the opponent-model dependence, not a pick.

cannot_answer.question: In-season lineup / waiver / start-sit / weekly projection advice?
cannot_answer.reason: Out of scope. This is a dynasty-startup valuation engine; no in-season weekly projection model is shipped.

cannot_answer.question: Completed 2026 (offseason) season results, standings, or stats?
cannot_answer.reason: 2026 is offseason / in-progress and is EXCLUDED from all models (latest complete season = 2025). Only ADP is live, and it is labeled '2026 (in-progress)'.

cannot_answer.question: Do college production or archetype clusters predict hits (yes/no)?
cannot_answer.reason: Cannot be answered yes/no. Archetypes are INDISTINGUISHABLE from draft capital (test-set DeLong CI excludes |gap|>~0.03 AUC); the college test was UNINFORMATIVE at these event counts (not a null). Neither is a usable predictive feature.

cannot_answer.question: Guaranteed / point-estimate future player points?
cannot_answer.reason: Projections are distributions with wide credible intervals (esp. QB), not point forecasts. A bare point would drop the mandatory interval.

cannot_answer.question: Trade/value for kickers, DST, IDP, or players absent from dim_player?
cannot_answer.reason: Out of scope — the engine covers QB/RB/WR/TE skill players in dim_player only.
